description.de: Expertenprofil

Mit einem kurzen Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade für die eingestellte Zeit ganz hoch. Ist eine Hochfahrverzögerungszeit eingestellt, so wird die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade erst nach Ablauf dieser Zeit hochgefahren. Mit einem langen Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade nur so lange hoch wie die Taste gedrückt ist.
description.en: With a short button press the awning / shutter will be moved up completely for the time set. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved up after the delay time has expired. With a long button press the awning / shutter will be moved up as long as the button will be pressed.
description.tr: Tusa kisa bir süre basildiginda tente / panjur belirlenen süre boyunca yukari kalkar. Gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa, güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir. Tusa uzun süre basildiginda tente / panjur sadece tusa basildigi süre boyunca yukari kalkar.

description.de: Mit einem kurzen Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade für die eingestellte Zeit ganz runter. Ist eine Runterfahrverzögerungszeit eingestellt, so wird die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade erst nach Ablauf dieser Zeit runtergefahren. Mit einem langen Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade nur so lange runter wie die Taste gedrückt ist.
description.en: With a short button press the awning / shutter will be moved down completely for the time set. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved up after the delay time has expired. With a long button press the awning / shutter will be moved down as long as the button will be pressed.
description.tr: Tusa kisa bir süre basildiginda tente / panjur belirlenen süre boyunca asagi iner. Gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa, güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir. Tusa uzun süre basildiginda tente / panjur sadece tusa basildigi süre boyunca asagi iner.

description.de: Mit einem kurzen Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade im Wechsel ganz hoch bzw. ganz runter (Togglefunktion). Ist eine Hoch- oder Runterfahrverzögerungszeit eingestellt, so wird die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade erst nach Ablauf dieser Zeit gefahren. Bei einem langen Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade so lange wie die Taste gedrückt ist.
description.en: With a short button press the awning / shutter will be moved up or down completely (toggle function) for the time set. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved up after the delay time has expired. With a long button press the awning / shutter will be moved for as long as the button will be pressed.
description.tr: Tusa kisa bir süre basildiginda tente / panjur ya tamamen yukari kalkar ya da tamamen asagi iner (Toggle fonksiyonu). Gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa, güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir. Tusa uzun süre basildiginda tente / panjur sadece tusa basildigi süre boyunca hareket eder.

description.de: Mit einem kurzen Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade für die eingestellte Zeit zur gewünschten Position. Ist eine entsprechende Fahrverzögerungszeit eingestellt, so wird die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade erst nach Ablauf dieser Zeit gefahren. Mit einem langen Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade nur so lange in die Richtung der gewünschten Position wie die Taste gedrückt ist.
description.en: With a short button press the awning / shutter will be moved to the desired position for the time set. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved up after the delay time has expired. With a long button press the awning / shutter will be moved for as long as the button will be pressed.
description.tr: Tusa kisa bir süre basildiginda tente / panjur belirlenen süre boyunca istenen pozisyona gelir. Gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa, güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir. Tusa uzun süre basildiginda tente / panjur sadece tusa basildigi süre boyunca hareket eder.

Mit dem Betätigen des Schalters fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade ganz hoch. Wird der Schalter während der Fahrt nochmal betätigt, wird die Fahrt unterbrochen. Bei der nächsten Betätigung wird die Fahrt wieder aufgenommen.
description.en: By operating the switch the awning / shutter will be moved up completely. If the switch is operated in the meantime the awning / shutter will be stopped. By operating the switch again, the awning / shutter will continue to move. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved to the desired position after the delay time has expired.
description.tr: Saltere basildiginda tente / panjur tamamen yukari kalkar. Saltere hareket sirasinda basildiginda ise durur ve saltere yeniden basildiginda tekrar hareket etmeye devam eder. Bir gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir.

description.de: Mit dem Betätigen des Schalters fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade ganz herunter. Wird der Schalter während der Fahrt nochmal betätigt, wird die Fahrt unterbrochen. Bei der nächsten Betätigung wird die Fahrt wieder aufgenommen.
description.en: By operating the switch the awning / shutter will be moved down completely. If the switch is operated in the meantime the awning / shutter will be stopped. By operating the switch again, the awning / shutter will continue to move. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved to the desired position after the delay time has expired.
description.tr: Saltere basildiginda tente / panjur tamamen asagi iner. Saltere hareket sirasinda basildiginda ise durur ve saltere yeniden basildiginda tekrar hareket etmeye devam eder. Bir gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir.

description.de: Mit jedem Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade im Wechsel ganz hoch bzw. ganz herunter (Togglefunktion). Wird die Taste während der Fahrzeit nochmals betätigt, bleibt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade augenblicklich stehen.
description.en: By operating the switch the awning / shutter will be moved up or down completely (toggle function) for the time set. If the switch is operated in the meantime the awning / shutter will be stopped. By operating the switch again, the awning / shutter will move into the other direction. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved to the desired position after the delay time has expired.
description.tr: Saltere her basildiginda tente / panjur ya tamamen yukari kalkar ya da tamamen asagi iner (Toggle fonksiyonu). Saltere hareket süresi sirasinda basildiginda ise durur ve saltere yeniden basildiginda diger yönde hareket etmeye devam eder. Bir gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir.

description.de: Mit jedem Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade ganz hoch. Ist eine Hochfahrverzögerungszeit eingestellt, so wird die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade erst nach Ablauf dieser Zeit hoch gefahren.
description.en: By operating the switch the awning / shutter will be moved up completely. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved to the desired position after the delay time has expired. If the switch is operated in the meantime the awning / shutter will be stopped. By operating the switch again, the awning / shutter will continue to move.
description.tr: Saltere her basildiginda tente / panjur tamamen yukari kalkar. Bir gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir. Bu hareket sirasinda saltere basilirsa gölgelik durur ve saltere tekrar basildiginda tekrar hareket eder.

description.de: Mit jedem Tastendruck fährt die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade ganz herunter. Ist eine Runterfahrverzögerungszeit eingestellt, so wird die Jalousie/Markise/Rolllade erst nach Ablauf dieser Zeit herunter gefahren.
description.en: By operating the switch the awning / shutter will be moved down completely. If a delay is set the awning / shutter will be moved to the desired position after the delay time has expired. If the switch is operated in the meantime the awning / shutter will be stopped. By operating the switch again, the awning / shutter will continue to move.
description.tr: Saltere her basildiginda tente / panjur tamamen asagi iner. Bir gecikme süresi ayarlanmissa güneslik bu süre dolduktan sonra hareket ettirilir. Bu hareket sirasinda saltere basilirsa gölgelik durur ve saltere tekrar basildiginda tekrar hareket eder.
